title: fabdep.yml
description: Configuration of fabdep (fabric-deploy): the Microsoft Fabric workspace each branch of a workspace repo deploys to, and how. Print this schema with `fabdep schema`.

workspace_base_name.description: {base} in workspace names: by default branch dev deploys to "<workspace_base_name> [DEV]". Required whenever a template in use contains {base}.

workspace_name_template.description: The workspace name of a branch whose environments entry names none. {base} is workspace_base_name, {branch} the branch name, {BRANCH} the branch name upper-cased; {{ and }} are literal braces.

environments.description: Settings per branch, keyed by branch name or glob (* matches any characters, ? one). A branch uses the entry of its exact name, else the first glob in file order that matches it, else none.

capacity_id.description: The Fabric capacity ID of workspaces fabdep creates. Without it fabdep uses the only active capacity, and fails when several are active.
capacity_id.patternErrorMessage: A capacity ID: a GUID, not the capacity's name.

tenant.description: The Microsoft Entra tenant ID every token must come from (`az account show --query tenantId --output tsv`). fabdep refuses a token from any other tenant before calling an API.
tenant.patternErrorMessage: A tenant ID: a GUID, not the tenant's name or domain.

auth.description: The credential to sign in with: cli (whoever `az login` signed in; the default), env (a service principal from AZURE_* variables), workload (a federated OIDC token file), managed (the host's managed identity) or default (azure-identity's DefaultAzureCredential). --auth and FABDEP_AUTH take precedence.

require_spn.description: Refuse user sign-ins: only an app-only token (a service principal or managed identity) may deploy.

manual_parameters.description: Find/replace rules on top of the IDs fabdep detects. A detected find_value gets this replace_value instead; any other find_value becomes a rule of its own if it occurs in an item file.

$comment: workspace_base_name is required unless no template in use contains {base}: workspace_name_template has none, or every environments entry names its workspace.

template.patternErrorMessage: Placeholders are {base}, {branch} and {BRANCH}; write {{ and }} for literal braces.

environment.description: Where and how the branch deploys.

workspace.description: The workspace name: a literal name or a template, like workspace_name_template (default: workspace_name_template).

environment.description: The fabric-cicd environment, which selects parameter.yml values and Variable Library value sets (default: the branch name).

create.description: Create the workspace when it doesn't exist.

find_value.description: The text to replace in item files, or a list of texts.

replace_value.description: The replacement: one value, or a mapping of fabric-cicd environment names (_ALL_ for any other) to values.

item_type.description: Apply the rule only to items of this type, or of these types (e.g. SemanticModel).

description.description: A label for a rule fabdep adds.
